description: This file extends the NodeAppModel with functions related to resolving URLs for Canvas and A2UI hosts, normalizing URLs for trust comparison, handling UI connections, and performing TCP port probing in a Swift-based iOS application.

classes.name: NodeAppModel
classes.description: A model class for node applications, extended here with URL resolution, normalization, and connectivity methods.

methods.name: resolveCanvasHostURL
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves the Canvas host URL, ensuring it's not a loopback.

methods.name: _test_resolveA2UIHostURL
methods.description: Test method for resolving the A2UI host URL.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostURL
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves the A2UI host URL, ensuring it's not a loopback, appending a specific path and suffix.

methods.name: normalizeURLForTrustComparison
methods.description: Normalizes a URL string by lowercasing scheme/host and removing fragments for trust comparison.

methods.name: showA2UIOnConnectIfNeeded
methods.description: Shows the default A2UI canvas upon connection if needed.

methods.name: ensureA2UIReadyWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Ensures the A2UI is ready, attempting to refresh capability if necessary, with timeout parameter.

methods.name: showLocalCanvasOnDisconnect
methods.description: Shows the default local canvas upon disconnect.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostURLWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Resolves the A2UI host URL, refreshing node canvas capability if needed.

methods.name: resolveCanvasHostURLWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Resolves the Canvas host URL, refreshing node canvas capability if needed.

methods.name: probeTCP
methods.description: Performs a TCP port probe asynchronously to check connectivity.
